segments.name: Mold Production
segments.description: The company's only operating segment, conducted through its PRC subsidiary Wuxi Mingteng Mould, sells all its products and services in China.
segments.evidence: Based on the management's assessment, the Company determined that it has only one operating segment and therefore one reportable segment as defined by ASC 280.

revenueModel.text: Customers in the PRC pay the company for the products and services it sells or provides there.
revenueModel.evidence: All of the Company's products and services are sold or provided in the PRC.
